name: ambix
character: The whole mix as a fifth-order sound field (AmbiX: ACN channel order, SN3D scaling). Any ambisonic decoder can put it on any loudspeakers or headphones afterwards, and it can still be rotated for head tracking or 360 video.
label: AmbiX sound field, order 5
sources: Nachbar, Zotter, Deleflie & Sontacchi (2011), AmbiX - a suggested ambisonics format: ACN ordering, SN3D normalisation
Loudness is set on channel 1 (W, the plain pressure) because a sound field has no loudness until it is decoded; the -3.0 dBTP ceiling is this project's delivery policy for a multichannel file
